evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date is a plain YYYY-MM-DD string with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/3 {"dueDate":"2026-09-01"} returned 200 and the date changed to 2026-09-01. PATCH /todos/1 {"dueDate":null} returned 200 with dueDate null. A later PATCH of only {"done":true} kept the cleared date.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30" returned 400. POST with "15.10.2026" returned 400. PATCH with "2026-13-01" returned 400. Each response was {"error":"dueDate must be a valid date..."}.
evidence.AC4: Today is 2026-10-15. The todos were: one past-due and open (3), one due today (4), one future (2), one without a date (1), one past-due but done (5). GET /todos?overdue=true returned only todo 3. The no-date, done, today and future todos were all excluded.
evidence.AC5: The page at / showed 'fällig 2026-12-01', 'fällig 2026-09-01', 'fällig 2026-10-15' and 'fällig 2026-10-01' next to the matching todos. Todos without a date showed none.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the open todo due 2026-09-01 carried the word 'überfällig'. The done past-due todo, the today todo, the future todo and the no-date todo had no marker.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled 'nur überfällige'. Before clicking it the list showed 5 todos. After clicking it the list showed only the overdue todo (the one due 2026-09-01).
